entry.title: Welcome to Triton AI
entry.summary: Discover our mission and what we’re building at UC San Diego.
entry.content:
We're excited to launch Triton AI's brand new website!

Why Join Us?​

  • Hands-on experience with LIDAR, GNSS, stereo vision, and real-time systems
  • A community of builders passionate about robotics
  • Opportunities to grow in leadership, engineering, and AI research
  • A growing online platform to share your work and contribute to open-source robotics

Check out our recruitment page to apply — and explore the rest of our new site while you're here!
